title: Shop Pen Plotter 36x48
ask: Approve a staged parts budget to build a 36" x 48" pen plotter in-house, starting with a $166 test order.
what_it_does: Draws white-on-blue architectural and engineering prints (and drafting film) up to ARCH E, 36" x 48", from SVG, PDF or DXF, with up to four pens per plot.
specs: up to 36" x 48" (ARCH E), any ARCH / ANSI size
+/-.008 in over the sheet, .001 in steps
Hiwin MGN15 linear rails, Gates GT2 9 mm belts, closed-loop NEMA17 steppers
FluidNC 6x, USB-C, microSD card, Wi-Fi, G-code
USB-C laptop or microSD card; Wi-Fi can be turned off
Sakura Gelly Roll white 08/10, Uni Posca PC-1MR / PC-3M, Rotring Isograph; .24-.63 in barrels
quick-change printed pen tools, manual swap at the front; room reserved for an automatic pen rack
47.6 x 69.7 in, on a 4 x 6 ft table

recommended.label: Recommended build (genuine brand parts)
recommended.notes: Every line priced from a manufacturer, authorized distributor or reputable reseller on 2026-10-05 (the aluminum plate on 2026-10-06). Shipping and tax not included. Three small items (M5 washers, 6 x 3 mm magnets, rubber strip) not yet priced.
groups: Hiwin MGN15 rails and blocks, MGN9 slide, Gates belt and pulleys, 3 closed-loop motor kits, Hitec servo and aluminum horn
2040 aluminum extrusion, 40 x 80 mm aluminum beam end-tapped, T-nuts, stainless screws, dowels, heat-set inserts
3/4 in MDF, galvanized steel facing, 30 rubber-coated magnets, contact cement
FluidNC 6x controller, 24 V supply, E-stop, switches, cable chains and cable, enclosure
1/4 in and 5/16 in 6061 plate 12 x 24 in, 4 x 4 x 1/4 in angle, 1 x 1 in bar
stages: MGN9 slide, servo + horn, Gates pulleys and idlers: confirms the design before any cutting. Pens for measuring add $20.10 (supplies).
Aluminum plate, angle and bar, all screws and bolts, heat-set inserts: everything needed to run the 19 CNC programs and print the parts.
2040 aluminum extrusion, T-nuts, corner brackets, 40 x 80 mm aluminum beam and dowels.
Hiwin rails and blocks, closed-loop motor kits, Gates belt.
MDF, galvanized steel, magnets, contact cement.
Controller, power supply, E-stop, switches, cable chains, cable, enclosure.

supplies.label: Pens, film and paper (not in any machine total)
items: Gelly Roll and Posca test pens
Dura-Lar matte film 40 in x 12 ft
Blue bond, 2 rolls 36 in x 500 ft

shop_parts.printed_parts: 3 pen tools, 6 straps, lift tab, servo bracket, X chain bracket, 3 switch brackets, dock stop, 3 idler spacers, pen setting block

checks: 19/19 CNC programs pass an automatic verifier and are backplotted
Collision check at all 4 travel corners, pen up and down: 0 interferences
Independent review read the changed programs line by line and swept the pen lift through its full travel
risk_first: Before cutting the pen dock, a $59 slide test measures seal drag on the pen-lift slide (Hiwin does not publish it). If it is too high, the slide is redesigned before any metal is cut for the head.
build_sources: Prices and specs: plotter/bom/buy-list.csv (with every vendor link).
